resources.name: Experimental data for rare gas solids (Bell & Zucker, 1976)

access.notes: Lattice parameters, second-order elastic constants C11, C12, C44, Debye temperatures, and Grüneisen parameters for Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe at low temperature. The agent may look up the values from Bell, R.J. and Zucker, I.J., in Rare Gas Solids, Academic Press, 1976, or from standard reference tables.
Python 3 with numpy and scipy. The agent may install from PyPI.
